hero.body: The Stablecoin Stack is a non-profit, vendor-neutral standard. No licensing fees. No shareholders. Sustained entirely by organisations and individuals who believe open infrastructure is worth protecting.

funds.body_1: The Foundation operates with minimal overhead. Contributions go directly toward maintaining the specification, running the reference implementation, and supporting the working groups that keep the standard moving forward.
funds.body_2: All spending is governed by the Foundation's members and disclosed in annual reports. There are no investment returns, equity stakes, or token allocations of any kind. This is operational funding for public infrastructure.

items.title: Specification maintenance
items.desc: Keeping the protocol current, reviewed, and documented as payments evolve.

items.title: Reference implementation
items.desc: Hosting, development, and upkeep of the open demonstration environment.

items.title: Working group operations
items.desc: Coordinating members, managing reviews, and facilitating consensus.

items.title: Security reviews
items.desc: Independent audits of the specification and reference implementation.

items.title: Public documentation
items.desc: Guides, integration resources, and educational materials — all free to access.

give_card.heading: Ways to contribute
give_card.subheading: All contributions support the Foundation's operating budget. No equity or financial return is offered or implied.
give_card.contact_sub: For larger contributions or institutional support
give_card.membership_sub: Shape the standard, not just support it
give_card.note: Contributions are operational grants to a non-profit organisation. They do not constitute an investment and carry no expectation of financial return.
give_card.crypto_subheading: Send directly to the Foundation's wallets. No intermediaries.

contact.body_1: If your organisation is considering a significant contribution, would like to discuss foundation membership, or has questions about how funding is used, reach out directly.
contact.body_2: The Foundation does not offer sponsorship packages, branded placements, or promotional arrangements in exchange for financial support. Our neutrality is not for sale.

form.message_placeholder: Tell us about your interest in supporting the Foundation.

disclaimer.para_1: The Fabric Payment Standards Foundation is a non-profit organisation. Financial contributions made to the Foundation are operational grants and are not investments. They do not entitle contributors to any equity, ownership interest, profit share, governance rights, tokens, or financial return of any kind.
disclaimer.para_2: Nothing on this page constitutes a solicitation of investment, a public offering of securities, or financial advice. If you have questions about the tax treatment of your contribution in your jurisdiction, please consult a qualified adviser.

footer.promise: Open standards. Neutral governance. Real-world adoption.
